Diamond Program:

• About our brand and products:

PureFrequencies is revolutionizing nervous system health through precision-tuned therapeutic frequencies. Our flagship Harmony Set uses 4 scientifically-calibrated tuning forks (128Hz, 136.1Hz, 256Hz, 384Hz) to reset the vagus nerve and restore balance to overwhelmed nervous systems. Founded on Nobel Prize-winning research and FDA-approved frequency protocols, we help people escape the cycle of anxiety, chronic pain, brain fog, and insomnia without medications or expensive treatments. Over 12,000 customers have discovered what 4 minutes a day can do.

• What makes us different:

Unlike supplements that take weeks or meditation apps that require discipline, our solution works in 30 seconds through pure physics. Every purchase includes our exclusive Frequency Mastery Masterclass - a comprehensive video training that transforms beginners into confident practitioners. While competitors just ship forks with basic instructions, we ensure success with professional guidance covering advanced techniques, specific protocols for different conditions, and the science behind each frequency.

We're the only company combining these exact 4 frequencies (Nobel Prize-winning research) with expert education. Our advertorials convert at 18% (industry average: 5-10%) because we address the root cause nobody talks about - frequency disruption - AND show exactly how to fix it. This product is absolutely crushing it on TikTok with viral transformation videos. With a proven funnel, premium price point ($89.95), included masterclass value ($197), and a unique mechanism that makes sense instantly, you're promoting a complete transformation system, not just another wellness product.

• How affiliates can earn:

Diamond Program partners earn 25% commission on all sales, instantly tracked through your unique link. Your audience automatically receives 10% off (no codes needed) while you earn $20+ per main product sale. With our upsell flow, average commission per customer reaches $26+. Payments process monthly via PayPal or direct deposit with no minimum threshold. Real-time dashboard shows every click, conversion, and commission. 30-day cookie duration ensures you get credit.

• How to promote us:

Record authentic videos showing your experience with the tuning forks - demonstrate the 30-second reset, share your before/after story, or explain the science. If you don't have the product yet, we can send you one for authentic promotion. Without product, you can still drive traffic to our high-converting advertorial that tells the full story. TikTok is going crazy for these transformation videos - show the forks in action, the instant calm effect, or just share how they changed your life. Target anyone with anxiety, chronic pain, brain fog, digestive issues, or insomnia - especially women 35-55.

• Other information:

We handle all customer service, shipping, and support - you just create content and send traffic. Average customer lifetime value exceeds $150 with our upsell line. Refund rate under 8%. No pre-made content provided - we want YOUR authentic voice and story. Based in UK with worldwide shipping. Our top TikTok affiliates are earning $10,000+ monthly with simple demonstration videos. The visual nature of tuning forks makes them perfect for social media. Questions? Email hello@purefrequencies.com
